[[Lieutenant Commander/Legends|Lieutenant Commander]] '''Kai''' was an [[Officer/Legends|officer]] serving the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] at [[Edan Base]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Edan II/Legends|Edan II]]. During the attack on the base by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces, Kai was in the [[Deflector shield/Legends|shield]] control bunker when communications was lost with it.
